"import json
import numpy as np
import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc

thermo_data = pyc.AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC

P = om.Problem()
model = P.model

model.add_subsystem('fc', pyc.FlightConditions(thermo_data=thermo_data), promotes=['*'])
model.add_subsystem('inlet', pyc.Inlet(thermo_data=thermo_data), promotes=['*'])
model.add_subsystem('comp', pyc.Compressor(map_data=pyc.AXI5, thermo_data=thermo_data,
                                           map_extrap=True), promotes=['*'])
model.add_subsystem('burner', pyc.Combustor(thermo_data=thermo_data), promotes=['*'])
model.add_subsystem('turb', pyc.Turbine(map_data=pyc.LPT2269, thermo_data=thermo_data), promotes=['*'])
model.add_subsystem('nozz', pyc.Nozzle(thermo_data=thermo_data, lossCoef=0.02), promotes=['*'])
model.add_subsystem('shaft', pyc.Shaft(num_ports=2), promotes=['*'])
model.add_subsystem('perf', pyc.Performance(num_nozzles=1, num_burners=1), promotes=['*'])

# Flow path
model.connect('fc.Fl_O', 'inlet.Fl_I')
model.connect('inlet.Fl_O', 'comp.Fl_I')
model.connect('comp.Fl_O', 'burner.Fl_I')
model.connect('burner.Fl_O', 'turb.Fl_I')
model.connect('turb.Fl_O', 'nozz.Fl_I')

# Shaft
model.connect('turb.trq', 'shaft.trq_0')
model.connect('comp.trq', 'shaft.trq_1')
model.connect('shaft.Nmech', 'comp.Nmech')
model.connect('shaft.Nmech', 'turb.Nmech')

# Performance
model.connect('nozz.Fl_O', 'perf.Fl_I_1')
model.connect('inlet.Fl_O', 'perf.Fl_I_0')
model.connect('burner.Fl_I', 'perf.Fl_I_1burn')

# Design: nozzle throat area set by turbine exit area
model.connect('turb.Fl_O:stat:area', 'nozz.Throat:stat:area')

# Balances: W for Fn target, Wfuel for T4 target
bal = om.BalanceComp()
model.add_subsystem('bal', bal)
bal.add_balance('W', val=150.0, units='lbm/s')
bal.add_balance('Wfuel', val=3.0, units='lbm/s')
model.connect('bal.W', 'inlet.W')
model.connect('perf.Fn', 'bal.lhs:W')
model.connect('bal.Wfuel', 'burner.Wfuel')
model.connect('burner.Fl_O:tot:T', 'bal.lhs:Wfuel')

# Solvers
newton = model.nonlinear_solver = om.NewtonSolver(solve_subsystems=True)
newton.options['maxiter'] = 50
newton.options['atol'] = 1e-8
newton.options['rtol'] = 1e-8
newton.options['iprint'] = 0
newton.linesearch = om.BoundsEnforceLS()
model.linear_solver = om.DirectSolver()

P.setup()

# Design point conditions: SL static
P.set_val('fc.alt', 0.0, units='ft')
P.set_val('fc.MN', 0.001)
P.set_val('fc.dTs', 0.0, units='degR')

# Targets
P.set_val('bal.rhs:W', 12000.0, units='lbf')
P.set_val('bal.rhs:Wfuel', 2450.0, units='degR')

# Cycle settings
P.set_val('comp.PR', 14.0)          # compressor OPR
P.set_val('turb.PR', 3.7)           # turbine pressure ratio (design set point)
P.set_val('inlet.MN', 0.6)
P.set_val('comp.MN', 0.6)
P.set_val('burner.MN', 0.25)
P.set_val('turb.MN', 0.6)
P.set_val('burner.dPfrac', 0.03)

# initial guesses (optional, ignore if inputs don't exist)
for name, val, units in [('nozz.MN', 1.5, None), ('shaft.Nmech', 10000., 'rpm')]:
    try:
        if units is None:
            P.set_val(name, val)
        else:
            P.set_val(name, val, units=units)
    except Exception:
        pass

P.run_model()

Fn = float(P.get_val('perf.Fn', units='lbf')[0])
TSFC = float(P.get_val('perf.TSFC', units='1/hr')[0])
p3 = float(P.get_val('comp.Fl_O:tot:P', units='psia')[0])
p2 = float(P.get_val('comp.Fl_I:tot:P', units='psia')[0])
OPR = p3 / p2
Wf = float(P.get_val('burner.Wfuel', units='lbm/s')[0])
T4 = float(P.get_val('burner.Fl_O:tot:T', units='degR')[0])

print('Fn =', Fn, 'lbf')
print('TSFC =', TSFC, '1/hr')
print('OPR =', OPR)
print('Wfuel =', Wf, 'lbm/s')
print('T4 =', T4, 'degR')

result = {
    'Fn_lbf': Fn,
    'TSFC': TSFC,
    'OPR': OPR,
    'Wfuel_lbm_s': Wf,
}
with open('result.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(result, f, indent=2)"
